sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipe1 bad pixel removal status register (DCMIPP_P1BPRSR)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.43 "DCMIPP Pipe1 bad pixel removal status register (DCMIPP_P1BPRSR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1934.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x828
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 BADCNT[11:0]: Amount of detected bad pixels
Counts the amount of bad pixels detected in each frame, and if too many, saturates at its
maximum value (4095). It is reclocked at the frame end, to remain stable for reading during
the next frame.
